facts.text: Undergraduate students at Hope International University are required to complete 18 units of Bible courses as part of their degree program.

sources.title: Undergraduate on Campus Transfer Students
sources.quote: Yes, our students take 18 units of Bible courses. We also offer weekly chapel services and small groups.
